title: feat(community-widgets): add comprehensive test suite for color refinement list widget
body:
## This PR has been superseded

This PR was created on the wrong repository. The color refinement list widget has its own dedicated repository.

**✅ Correct PR Location:**  
https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch-widget-color-refinement-list/pull/5

### What happened
- This PR was initially created on the InstantSearch monorepo
- The widget actually lives in a separate repository: `algolia/react-instantsearch-widget-color-refinement-list`
- Work has been moved to the correct repository (PR [#5](https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch-widget-color-refinement-list/pull/5))

### Summary of Changes (now in correct repo)
- Upgrade to React InstantSearch v7 (v2.0.0)
- Comprehensive test suite (84 tests, ~85% coverage)
- Migration guide and updated documentation
- Centralised Algolia credentials configuration

This PR is **closed** and the branch has been deleted.  
Please review the work at the correct location: **[PR #5](https://github.com/algolia/react-instantsearch-widget-color-refinement-list/pull/5)** ☝️
